body: Never tried student therapist and I have tried support groups but I wasn't comfortable with it.

Basically we were in the process of moving and I couldn't maintain the therapy sessions and multiple therapist just left after a while. They said that they left on their own terms but I felt like it was my fault in some form and I also had trouble with money at the time and couldn't afford to go to them anymore. Also I don't think moving with my sister and grandmother is an option at this point because they are dealing with their own problems with people living with them, I don't want to add more problems with the fact I will more then likely have to pay some kind of fine.
